author: (White, 1848)

note.en: A small rubble crab listed by WoRMS for the Costa Rican Caribbean; it is too small and hidden to notice without a specimen in hand.
note.es: Un cangrejo pequeño de escombro listado por WoRMS para el Caribe de Costa Rica; es demasiado pequeño y escondido para notarlo sin tenerlo en la mano.

evidence: WoRMS distribution: Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea
GBIF: one record in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro
